posts.text: Lucchini RS strengthens its global reach with a strategic entry into India’s integrated railway industry - QuiBrescia QuiBrescia – 3 Aug 26 Lucchini RS strengthens its global reach with a strategic entry into India’s... Lucchini RS enters India’s railway market with Jupiter Wagons: an integrated platform for wheels, axles and wheelsets, supported by SIMEST and the Italian system.
